messages:
Lena Park: Customer wants a compact observability demo: route leaderboard + quick jump-to-trace + error-slice summary. Need a single-sprint scope decision: hybrid pre-agg vs real-time compute.

Vikram Das: Hybrid wins for demo: pre-agg 24h + live 5m estimate for top-k routes. Gives 'now' view without blowing infra.

Maya Chen: UX: show two columns: 24h (pre-agg) and live-5m (estimated). Add a small badge 'estimated' and an info popover explaining sampling. Demo must be read-only.

Diego Alvarez: Backend notes: pre-agg pipeline = ~3d infra + 1d backend. Live-5m sampler for top-k = ~2d backend + safety throttle. Will add a coverage metric 'obs_cost_coverage'.

Arjun Singh: Ops: no auto-rollback. Canary to 10% orgs. Alert if 5xx delta >0.7% sustained 20m. Expose feature flag obs_live_est and metric live_est_cpu_delta.

Lena Park: Acceptance for demo: top-10 accuracy >=80% (marked), trace links resolve >=95% for sampled traces, dashboard P95 <2.5s on demo load. Agree?

Vikram Das: Agreed. We'll surface coverage % in footer to set expectation.

Maya Chen: I'll prepare mock with two-column layout and tooltip copy. Use synthetic traces for demo.

Diego Alvarez: I'll open tickets: PRO-900 (Hybrid leaderboard + trace links), PRO-901 (Sampler + coverage metric), PRO-902 (Ops runbook).

infra-bot: Canary window reserved: 2025-04-20 03:00-05:00 UTC. :rocket:

Lena Park: Locking scope for demo: org-level leaderboard (24h pre-agg + live-5m est), trace links to synthetic traces, estimated badge, coverage footer. Demo date 4/30. If blockers, call out in PRO-900.
